name: Sophia Höfling
headline: COO @ReiCat | Powering Progress with Purer Gases | Clean Tech Entrepreneur🌱
summary:
I’ve spent the past 10+ years building tech companies, products, and teams from 0 to 1. In 2022, I’ve joined our clean tech family business ReiCat. With my father, I’m leading the business focussed on driving forward automation and growth and building a data-driven culture.

As an entrepreneur, I love the maker spirit of the early days and the system design required to scale an organization and its culture. 

As a product leader, I enjoy working on solutions that leverage tech (robotics, computer vision, NLP, RPA, catalyst technology etc.) in new ways. I believe in sustainable & ethical design. I am convinced that the best products are built by cross-functional teams.

As a manager, I’m excited about turning diverse groups into teams and seeing people grow.

I speak and write about hydrogen, clean tech, leadership, female empowerment, product, and life-centered design.

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
For more than 40 years, we have supplied process engineering plants for technical gas and exhaust air treatment. Over 600 ReiCat systems operate in 60 countries worldwide purifying more than 1.6 Mio Nm3/h of gas and exhaust air. We proudly count some of the world's largest companies among our 300 happy customers.

Our gas recycling systems enable customers to decrease their production costs and CO2 emissions tremendously. Our gas purification units remove unwanted impurities - such as moisture and residual oxygen from green hydrogen - to increase the value of a gas by a multiple. Our exhaust air purification units, powered by sophisticated catalyst technology, are designed to purify air at the highest efficiency and lowest operating cost.
